    Rest periodMonitoring is on

    A manual pause for sleep or deliberate stillness. No events are raised while paused, and the timer starts fresh when it ends. Nothing is detected automatically.

    Before you begin

    1. Mount the camera so shoulders and hips stay in view.
    2. Keep one crew member in frame with steady lighting.
    3. Use replay to test an alert safely.

    Experimental detection, not a medical device. Sleep, focused reading or holding still on purpose can trigger an alert. Drifting or tumbling without limb movement still counts as no movement.

    Offline use

    Preparing offline shell…

    Replay, alerts and the guest journal work offline once cached. The camera model is a separate download. Camera Coach, accounts and MUSE need a connection. The browser may clear its cache.

    How was your day

    Guest entries stay in this browser. Signed in, they are saved to your account. Only what you send to MUSE goes to Meta. Theme summaries and sentiment describe your words, not your health.

    About the sentiment dataset

    Uses human-rated English words from the VADER lexicon with a custom wording heuristic, not the full VADER algorithm. Sarcasm, quotations and context can change the meaning. No clinical or astronaut-wellness validation. Local analysis does not upload text. The separate MUSE button sends the selected entry to Meta.

    Your entries

    Your recent photos next to the sleep you logged yourself. This shows what you recorded; it is not a health assessment.

    Account photos are stored on the server, not encrypted, as JPEGs of at most 768 px. Delete an entry or use Delete all to remove them.

    Sign in

    An account saves your journal on the server and lets MUSE recall related past entries. Everything else works as a guest.
